fields.label: Merchant Trading Name
fields.description: Self-declared. Snapshotted onto each sale at charge.

fields.label: Mode
fields.description: Mainnet is a non-working mode by decision. Selecting it produces a refusal at charge, which is the intended behaviour.

fields.label: Loyalty Earn Rate (points per cent)
fields.description: 0 means earning is not offered. Not the redemption rate, which lives in the contract and cannot change at all.

fields.label: Bitcoin testnet4 Address
fields.description: The merchant's own testnet address. Empty means no configured identity, and a sale will record identity_source = none rather than pretend otherwise.

fields.label: Policy Tier (Ootle loyalty)
fields.description: EARNING ONLY. Points accrue and cannot be devalued. Spending does not work yet: a redemption needs the customer to co-sign and no wallet in reach can do that. Do not tell a customer they can spend these.

fields.label: Offer Loyalty Points
fields.description: Off means no points are offered and no award is attempted. Nothing here can ever fail a sale.

fields.label: Ootle Indexer
fields.description: Reading is free and keyless. This is the URL a customer can open to check the promise themselves.

fields.label: Loyalty Component
fields.description: Superseded components still resolve and still answer. A wrong address here reads a ledger nobody is being awarded into.

fields.label: Points Resource
fields.description: Checked against the resource the component itself names. A mismatch is refused rather than read.

fields.label: How Awards Are Written
fields.options: Awards are queued here and written by a drainer running on the host, because the signing key deliberately never enters this container. An award that cannot be written never blocks a sale.

fields.label: What A Settled Sale Books Into
Default Customer
fields.description: Walk-in customer used for the emitted Sales Invoice.

fields.label: Default Item
fields.description: The line item a keypad sale books against.
